objective: Insure against loss of public distribution by preserving valuable learned outcomes and their dependencies. Early-restriction scenarios order preparation but are not the sole eligibility test; daily-use optimization is separate.

requirements: real primary model identity (HF id or Civitai version id)
modality, technical training/weight modification mechanism
current source date and origin
no duplicate active representative without stated distinct mechanism
source and author technical evidence
at least one plausible competitive task quality dimension
research-only conditional can have incomplete full total with explicit NON_EXECUTABLE marker; final lock requires verified total
verified original identity and metadata
relevant technical mechanism not replicated by incumbent
no contradictory serious performance failure unaddressed; negative evidence documented
full total under 150B or validated exception before approved lock; research stage may still be conditional nonexecutably
Over150B quantized assets remain HOLD/research only until matched reference RAM and all runtime and rights gates verified; parameter count alone not a ban
same-purpose baseline task quality independent or reproducible with confidence limits
distinct functionality or weight reconstruction difficulty
meaningful on fixed hardware
source licensing text studied; gaps explicitly documented
documented lawful basis for the intended act (express license, valid exception, or rights-holder permission), plus actual parent/derivative use restrictions
individual gated/paid access authorized in normal provider flow
immutable repo/revision and all selected files SHA256
exact bytes and actual free disk minus staging >=200GB
peak RAM and speed quality measured when oversized
explicit separately user-approved lock

Over150B: measured candidate peak RAM <= pinned active under150B reference peak RAM under same hardware/backend/context/batch with >=30 trials each, in addition to absolute <512GB and quality/speed/rights

evidence_grades.A: independent matched, reproducible task experiment with code, N, hardware, dataset split, confidence interval
evidence_grades.B: third-party measurements with partial protocol or creator measured with full settings
evidence_grades.C: model card claims, user feedback, downloads, size or qualitative samples

non_compensatory_rule: No weighted ranking, downloads, likes, claimed uncensor level, model size or forecast tier can override missing legal/identity/total/runtime rights. For optional research priority first compare S1/S2/S3, unique mechanism, observed changes and quality within an evidence grade.
conditional_minimum_quality: Credible evidence of a distinct learned mechanism or research value, with negative evidence recorded; neither imminent-ban proof nor overall benchmark superiority is required for conditional archival selection. Acquisition and existing oversized runtime gates remain separate.

metrics: creative roleplay paired preference if specialized
llm.caution: Test only under authorized controlled safety evaluation. No malicious payload dissemination.

image.caution: Only consenting-adult source imagery for identity-related tests

limits: prompt injection and harmful content are distinct tasks

metrics: peak host RAM and VRAM without double-counting unified memory
quality change between quant and original

statistics.binary: Wilson 95% confidence intervals; report numerator and denominator; compare paired items when possible
statistics.continuous: bootstrap 95% CI for paired differences and median across >=30 independent runs
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm control or disclose exploratory results; freeze thresholds before seeing holdout
statistics.stop_rule: do not stop early for apparent success; stop for legal/safety restriction, unrecoverable failures, or protocol-specified futility
statistics.u_c: unknown unless measurement error budget documented

verdict_conditions.PASS: quality noninferiority or domain-specific improvement on pre-registered test and complete required rights/manifest/runtime evidence
verdict_conditions.FAIL: verified legal prohibition, infeasible runtime, harmful unsupported quality degradation, or duplicate with no distinct value
verdict_conditions.UNCERTAIN: missing, contaminated, weak or contradictory evidence => HOLD/conditional depending selection stage; never approve downloads

manual_user_override: User may explicitly preserve unique heavy models like Nanbeige dense 33B; maintain rights/runtime and manifest rules.
